cli.description: BA Modding Toolkit - Command Line Interface.
cli.updateHelp: One-click update for mods, porting assets from an old mod to a new game file.
cli.updateDescription:
Example:
  # Auto-search for new file and update
  python cli.py update --old-mod "C:\path\to\old_mod.bundle" --game-dir "C:\path\to\game_data" --output-dir "C:\path\to\output"

  # Manually specify new file and update
  python cli.py update --old-mod "C:\path\to\old_mod.bundle" --new-bundle "C:\path\to\new_game_file.bundle" --output-dir "C:\path\to\output"

  # Specify multiple asset types to replace
  python cli.py update --old-mod "..." --new-bundle "..." --output-dir "..." --asset-types Texture2D TextAsset
cli.oldModHelp: Path to the old mod bundle file.
cli.newBundleHelp: Path to the new game asset bundle file (if provided, takes precedence over --game-dir).
cli.gameDirHelp: Path to the game asset directory, used to automatically find a matching new bundle file.
cli.outputDirHelp: Directory to save the generated new mod file.
cli.assetTypesHelp: List of asset types to replace (default: Texture2D, Mesh).
cli.replacePngHelp: Replace content in the target bundle file with content from a PNG image folder.
cli.bundleHelp: Path to the target bundle file to be modified.
cli.imageFolderHelp: Path to the folder containing .png images. The image filename (without extension) must match the asset name inside the bundle.
cli.outputDirHelpPng: Directory to save the modified bundle file.
